assumptions: Recorded names merged to accepted_name via taxonomy.csv (synonyms from the two labs summed); all 24 samples used, raw counts, no rarefaction.
issues: Labs used different names for the same species (e.g. Globigerinoides sacculifer/Trilobatus sacculifer, G. tenellus/Globoturborotalita tenella, N. pachyderma dextral/sinistral renamed to N. incompta/N. pachyderma); merged under current taxonomy.
summary: Merged synonyms, counted species with >=1 specimen, mean Bray-Curtis over all 276 sample pairs on raw counts.
